remarks.para: This method constructs optimized lookup structures essential for hierarchical filtering in TreeGrid:

item.description: _itemLookup: Maps unique IDs to TreeListItem objects for O(1) item retrieval
_childMap: Groups children by parent ID for efficient parent-to-children navigation
_parentLookup: Maps child IDs to parent objects for child-to-parent traversal
_originalOrderMap: Preserves data source order for consistent result ordering
